svg.aria-label: airflow-migration-template: A platform template for moving legacy ETL jobs to Airflow: one pipeline runs on DuckDB or Postgres. 8 / 8: self-test checks pass on DuckDB and on PostgreSQL. Redshift and cloud storage adapters were not run live.
